title: Self-serve plans
snippet:
| Plan | For | Price | Members |
|---|---|---|---|
| **Free** | Individuals trying Devin | Free | 1 |
| **Pro** | Individual users | $20/month | 1 |
| **Max** | Power users who need more quota | $200/month | 1 |
| **Teams** | Teams working with Devin together | $80/month | Multiple |

## Free
The Free plan lets you try Devin with limited usage. It includes:
- Limited Devin usage
- Access to [Devin Review](/work-with-devin/devin-review)
- Access to [DeepWiki](/work-with-devin/deepwiki)
Free users can upgrade to any paid plan at any time from [Settings > Plans](https://app.devin.ai/settings/plans).
## Pro
Pro is Devin’s entry-level individual plan. It’s designed for a single developer who uses Devin regularly. Pro includes:
- A daily and weekly usage quota that covers Devin sessions, [Devin CLI](/cli), and [Devin Desktop](https://windsurf.com)
- Pay-as-you-go on-demand credits for usage past your quota
- Slack, Linear, and [MCP](/work-with-devin/mcp) integrations
Pro is a single-user plan. Pro subscribers cannot invite additional members to their organization. To work with teammates on a shared subscription, use the Teams plan.
## Max
Max is for individual users who consistently exceed the Pro quota. It includes everything in Pro, plus a significantly larger weekly usage quota (with no daily cap), also shared between Devin sessions, [Devin CLI](/cli), and Devin Desktop. Like Pro, Max is a single-user plan and does not support multiple members.

### Free mode
On the Teams plan, every member can pick **Free (powered by SWE-2)** in the agent selector to run Devin cloud sessions at no cost. Each member can run up to **2 Free sessions at a time**; to start a third, wait for one to finish or pick another mode. Sessions in other modes are billed as usual.

- Upgrade or downgrade between Free, Pro, Max, and Teams with the button on each plan’s card: **Purchase** from the Free plan, **Upgrade** or **Downgrade** from a paid plan. To cancel a paid plan, select **Downgrade** on the Free card.

title: docs.devin.ai/llms-full.txt
snippet:
Devin has two pricing models:
* **Self-serve**: Free, Pro, Max, and Teams plans you can sign up for directly at [app.devin.ai](https://app.devin.ai). Self-serve usage is billed through a mix of included quota and on-demand credits. See [Self-serve plans](/admin/billing/self-serve) for full details.
* **Enterprise**: Devin Enterprise customers are billed in Agent Compute Units (ACUs) at the rate set in their order form. See [Enterprise](/admin/billing/enterprise) for how ACU consumption is tracked, or [contact sales](https://cognition.com/contact) for pricing.

* **ChatGPT plans:** You can share a personal ChatGPT **Go**, **Plus**, or **Pro** plan with Devin. You cannot share a Free plan, or a Business, Team, or Enterprise workspace account.
* **Devin plans:** Token sharing is available on the [self-serve](/admin/billing/self-serve) **Pro**, **Max**, and **Teams** plans. It's not available on the Free plan or on Enterprise accounts. If you're on the Free plan, you'll see an **Upgrade your plan to connect ChatGPT** prompt in settings.

title: Pro $20, Max $200, Teams From $80 a Month
snippet:
Devin has four self-serve plans and an Enterprise contract, and each paid plan buys you a usage quota rather than a fixed number of tasks. We read every row from Devin's [pricing page](https://devin.ai/pricing) and its [self-serve billing docs](https://docs.devin.ai/admin/billing/self-serve) on 8 November 2026. US prices, before tax:
| Plan, read 8 November 2026 | Price | Users | Usage included | Past the quota |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Free | $0 | 1 | A "light quota" for the agent and limited models | Upgrade |
| Pro | $20 a month | 1 | Daily and weekly quota for Devin sessions, Devin CLI and Devin Desktop; frontier models; SWE-2 free | On-demand credits at API pricing |
| Max | $200 a month | 1 | A "significantly larger" weekly quota, no daily cap | On-demand credits at API pricing |
| Teams, full seat | $40 a seat; $80 a month minimum per team | Up to 200 | A Pro-sized daily and weekly quota, plus Devin Desktop | Shared on-demand credits |
| Teams, flex seat | $0 | Counts toward the 200 | None; draws from shared credits, no Devin Desktop | Shared on-demand credits |
| Enterprise | Custom | By contract | ACUs at the rate in the order form; VPC deployment, SAML and OIDC SSO | Budgets set by admins |

| | Before 14 April 2026, archived 17 February 2026 | From 14 April 2026, read 8 November 2026 |
|---|---|---|
| Entry plan | Core: pay as you go from $20, at $2.25 per ACU | Pro: $20 a month with a daily and weekly quota |
| Team plan | Team: $500 a month with 250 ACUs, $2.00 each | Teams: $80 a month minimum, $40 per full seat |
| Past the allowance | More ACUs at $2.25 (Core) or $2.00 (Team) | On-demand credits at API pricing |
| Top plan for one person | None between Core and Team | Max at $200 a month |
| Enterprise | Custom, billed in ACUs | Custom, ACUs at the order-form rate |

## Is Devin free?
Yes. Devin Free costs $0 and includes "Limited Devin usage," Devin Review and DeepWiki, according to the self-serve docs. The pricing page calls the agent allowance a "light quota" on a limited set of models. You can't link a ChatGPT plan on Free.
Some of Cognition's tools stay free on any plan. Cognition said in April that Devin Review stays free on open source repos, and that deepwiki.com and its standard wiki generation stay free too. What isn't free since April: Deep Mode in Ask Devin, Devin Review on other repos after a 2-week free trial, and the pricier DeepWiki modes.

title: Devin Pricing (2026): Free, Pro $20, Max $200, Teams $80
snippet:
Devin has a free plan; Pro costs $20 a month and Max $200 a month, each for one user. Teams is self-serve at a flat $80 a month, with shared on-demand credits for up to 100 members, and Enterprise is quoted by Cognition's sales team. Pro gets a daily and a weekly quota, Max a much larger weekly quota with no daily cap. Past the quota you spend prepaid on-demand credits at API pricing, and those never expire.

| Plan | Price | What you get | Past the quota |
|---|---|---|---|
| Free | $0 | A light quota and limited models | Wait for the quota |
| Pro | $20 a month | A daily and a weekly quota, every model, Devin Cloud | On-demand credits at API pricing |
| Max | $200 a month | A much larger weekly quota, no daily cap | On-demand credits at API pricing |
| Teams | A flat $80 a month | One pool of credits shared by up to 100 members, no per-member quota | Admins top up the shared credits |
| Enterprise | Quoted | ACUs on an order form | Budgets set by admins |
## What the free plan includes
A light quota for coding with agents, a limited set of models, and unlimited inline edits and Tab completions. Cloud agents (Devin Cloud) and the full model list start on Pro. Cognition shows no annual prices and no trial on its pricing page.
## Devin Pro vs Max: what $180 more buys
Quota and nothing else that matters day to day. Pro, at $20, has a daily quota and a weekly quota, both shared across Devin sessions, the Devin CLI and Devin Desktop, with full model availability (Cognition lists frontier models from "OpenAI, Claude, Gemini, and SpaceXAI" and leading open source ones), plus free use of SWE-2, Cognition's own model. Max, at $200, keeps everything in Pro and gives what Cognition calls significantly higher quotas: a weekly quota only, with no daily cap. Cognition does not say how many times Pro's usage that is.

### Is Devin free?
There is a free plan with a light quota, limited models, unlimited inline edits and unlimited Tab completions. Cloud agents (Devin Cloud) and every model start on Pro.
